findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed score window is [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and replaced by an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity target or terminal-label benefit is observable in the supplied evidence.

Continuous contrast functions are reported only over the observed support with extrapolation disallowed and observed-node linear interpolation; the inspected landmark_00 features show multiple sign changes (4 to 10) and strong sign conflicts (1 to 9) with no accepted polynomial, so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule must stay within the observed window.

The inspected landmark_00 local features have whole-window z values near zero (magnitudes below about 0.64) despite large first/last rate z values, indicating that endpoint rate changes are not accompanied by a consistent whole-window signed coordinate contrast; these are coordinate contrasts, not physical interaction energies or neural-module causation.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant rule matching the observed-node contrasts within the reported relative node RMSE, or a sign-consistent whole-window contrast, would weaken this hypothesis.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00 local coordinate contrast features at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention rule over the observed score window may better track the sign-changing landmark_00 coordinate contrasts than a constant rule, because the inspected features show multiple sign changes and no accepted polynomial fit.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Selection enrichment, survival, increment and turnover diagnostics were not read in this turn; no claim is made about them.
The inspected evidence covers only landmark_00 continuous trends; other regions and joint diagnostics remain unexamined.
No temperature edit is proposed or permitted; temperatures are immutable task parameters.
